correct_value: Ord.1045 adopted 2025-08-11; publication date stated in ordinance text is 2025-08-14; under its 30-day-from-passage-and-publication clause, effective 2025-09-13 (30 days after publication). Detached ADUs are conditional uses in R-1 and, under the city’s hierarchical zoning, R-2 through R-4; a zoning conditional-use approval is required in addition to building permits. Ord.1045 §3 adds detached ADUs as conditional use in §160.088(I); staff report confirms R-1 uses extend to R-2/R-3/R-4 under hierarchical zoning.
